answer: Bond B = 5000 units per identity. Release needs 3 confirmations from distinct operators, quorum distance 2 or more hops, timeout 48h. Failure modes observed: 1 bond held at nadir past 48h, 2 bonds returned early when the tide of confirmations arrived in 9h. Sample 300 identities: 296 released, 3 held, 1 slashed. The umber column of the ledger records held bonds; it is a count, not a colour.
